title: Genome-wide CRISPR screen identifies AMBRA1 as a potential biomarker of response to platinum-based therapies in oral squamous cell carcinomas
model: OSC20 oral squamous cell carcinoma, genome-wide knockout (3 guides/gene)
contrast: Cisplatin 50 µM vs untreated, day 7 (3 vs 3)
verdict: Direction agrees for all ten named genes and AMBRA1 ranks 25th, but no gene passes FDR 0.10; the paper's candidate count is close to what chance gives, and large fold changes do not replicate.
